The '''Santhe family''' was one of the ruling houses of [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. They controlled the holdings of [[Santhe Corporation/Legends|Santhe Corporation]] as well as its  subsidiaries  [[Santhe Security]] and the later [[Santhe/Sienar Technologies]]. Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[99 BBY/Legends|99 BBY]], [[Kerred Santhe]] acquired a controlling share of [[Sienar Technologies]].
